verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an identity-verification platform, since such vendors can offer on-premise deployment, so the axis applies. Every evidence item describes Veriff-hosted services: sessions created via Veriff's API, decisions sent by Veriff webhooks, and review in the Veriff Customer Portal. Nothing in the pack documents a self-hosted or on-premise deployment of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
